description: Lists the user's analyses (runs), newest first: id, title, status, preset, package status and price. Requires sign-in (OAuth connector or API key) with the runs:read scope. Use it to find a `run_id` when the user refers to earlier work. For the progress or details of one analysis use qualitative_get_run. Returns at most `limit` entries (default 50, maximum 100).
name: qualitative_list_runs
title: List my analyses
